subject.title: fix(browser): keep CDP cursor text previews UTF-16 safe

question: Should OpenClaw require cursor preview strings to be surrogate-safe before CDP `returnByValue`, and if so should this stronger residue-scrubbing branch be the canonical implementation?
rationale: The patch is technically sound and proven, but it hardens an intermediate representation rather than fixing current final output, and a competing implementation has been proposed; repository intent is needed to avoid duplicate policy.

options.title: Adopt this transport invariant
options.body: Refresh the branch, complete checks, land this stronger page-local helper, and close the competing browser branch as non-canonical.

options.title: Keep the current pipeline
options.body: Decline the extra intermediate invariant because the existing Node re-cut already guarantees safe final cursor text, and close both hardening branches.

recommendation.title: Adopt this transport invariant
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch, complete checks, land this stronger page-local helper, and close the competing browser branch as non-canonical.
